titleBar.wait: Wait until the installation is complete

welcome.updateLead: You are going from version {from} to {to}. Your computers, their passwords and your settings stay where they are.
welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.title: Your computer, on this PC.
welcome.lead: Find your computer's screen right here, as if it were in front of you: the picture in a few milliseconds, and a keyboard, mouse and gamepad that respond instantly.
welcome.note: One minute, just for you, no administrator rights needed. Nothing changes on this PC until you click {action}.
welcome.desktopNote: KyberNow is in the Start menu either way.
welcome.willClose: KyberNow will be closed during installation.

close.title: Closing KyberNow
close.text: The open app closes for the duration of the installation.

files.title: The KyberNow {version} app
files.text: Its files go into your own folder, without touching the rest of the PC.

webview.title: WebView2 display engine
webview.text: Downloaded from Microsoft and installed for you.

shortcuts.title: Start menu and kybernow:// link
shortcuts.text: The link or QR code from a computer's console opens KyberNow directly.
shortcuts.warn: to redo: open KyberNow once and it registers itself again

register.title: Installed apps
register.text: KyberNow updates itself, and uninstalls like any other app.

install.title: Your computer is coming to this PC.
install.lead: Nothing to do: we show you each step as it happens.

done.title: KyberNow is ready.
done.updateLead: Your computers are waiting for you on the home screen, with their settings.
done.lead: Open it: a computer on the same network shows up on its own. Otherwise, add it with the link or QR code from its console, or by its address.
done.where: It is also waiting for you in the Start menu. Right-click its icon in the taskbar: your computers, one click away.
done.whereDesktop: It is also waiting for you in the Start menu and on the desktop. Right-click its icon in the taskbar: your computers, one click away.
done.bar: Moving the mouse to the top of the screen shows the session bar.

about.note: KyberNow is distributed under the AGPL-3.0. The licence texts are in the project repository, on GitHub.

mock.arm64: The ARM64 version of KyberNow will be installed: it runs without emulation, with the chip's video decoding.
mock.x64: The x64 version of KyberNow will be installed.
mock.gpu: {name}: it decodes the picture, for lower latency and longer battery life.
mock.display: 2560 × 1600 · 120 Hz: your computer can take exactly this size during the session.
mock.network: 192.168.1.20: a computer on this network shows up in KyberNow on its own.
mock.webview: Version 141.0.3537.71, by Microsoft: it draws the KyberNow interface.
mock.existing: It will be updated. Your computers, their passwords and your settings stay.
mock.running: It will be closed during installation: a session in progress will stop.
